heroes.name: Luther
heroes.description: Silent demon hunter who is always the first to jump into the fray, so keep out of his way.
heroes.relic_note: Mages better stay away from Luther! His Relic helps him reduce nearby enemies' Magic Attack, deal more Physical Damage, and stun enemies more often. Power up Luther and send him straight into the heart of battle.

synergies.reason: A recommended Way of Honor teammate for Luther's Relic teams. Together with Guus and Tristan, Crow fits the physical-damage compositions suggested for Luther.

Boosts Luther's Critical Hit Chance, helping his Relic's Physical Damage become more threatening. With his own Relic, Guus also provides substantial Health and Critical Hit Chance. Luther's first Relic skill is especially useful against enemies who deal damage over time.
Provides Armor Penetration to support Luther's increased Physical Damage with his Relic. Tristan is a Way of Honor teammate who fits Luther's physical-damage teams.

strong_against.reason: Unshakable Faith reduces nearby enemies' Magic Attack, while Doctrine of Faith increases Luther's Magic Defense, helping him withstand Intelligence-based magic damage dealers.
Luther's Relic reduces her Magic Attack when she is nearby, while his increased Magic Defense helps him withstand her magic attacks.
Luther combines nearby Magic Attack reduction with increasing Magic Defense, making him a strong option against this Intelligence-based damage dealer.
Luther can jump into the enemy formation and reduce Kendle's Magic Attack while nearby, weakening his magic damage output.

skills.name: Sentence
skills.description: Stuns nearby enemies and damages them.
skills.note: Chance to stun is lowered if the target's level is above 120.

skills.name: Omen
skills.description: Luther moves deep into the enemy team, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Gehenna
skills.description: Landing after using Omen, Luther creates a fiery wave that deals Physical Damage and stuns enemies around him for 2 seconds.
skills.note: Chance to stun is lowered if the target's level is above 120.

skills.name: Gehenna (enhancement)
skills.description: The skill now activates not only after Omen, but also every 11 seconds.
skills.alexandre_tips: With the Relic, Gehenna activates after Omen and every 11 seconds, so Luther deals area damage and stuns nearby enemies more often.

skills.name: Doctrine of Faith
skills.description: Passive skill. Increases own Magic Defense. Each time Luther takes Magic Damage, he increases his Magic Defense further for 4 seconds.
skills.alexandre_note: Luther's base fourth skill was recently updated. Even without a Relic, it now increases his Magic Defense and grants an additional Magic Defense increase for 4 seconds each time he takes Magic Damage.

skills.name: Doctrine of Faith (enhancement)
skills.description: Now, when taking Magic Damage, Luther also increases his Armor Penetration for 4 seconds.
skills.alexandre_tips: Luther now boosts not only his Magic Defense, but also his Armor Penetration. With his Relic, he can deal substantial damage, especially alongside Guus, and this skill makes him less dependent on allies for Armor Penetration.

skills.name: Righteous Retribution
skills.description: Every 12 seconds, Luther starts accumulating Righteousness. All incoming damage charges it for 8 seconds. When the timer expires or when Luther dies, he deals Physical Damage equal to accumulated charge to enemies around him.
skills.alexandre_tips: Any damage Luther takes during the accumulation window charges his counterattack. The charge gained depends on his current Magic Defense, which his updated fourth skill increases further. Luther then deals Physical Damage to nearby enemies, making this a useful answer to mages and heroes who deal damage over time.

skills.name: Unshakable Faith
skills.description: While Luther is alive, all enemies around him have their Magic Attack decreased.
skills.alexandre_tips: Another powerful skill against mages: Luther constantly reduces the Magic Attack of all nearby enemies while he is alive, and this effect cannot be removed. Jumping into a mage team lets him apply this pressure inside the enemy formation. It is especially useful against mages and heroes with Intelligence as their main stat.
strong_against: Heroes with Intelligence as their main stat

glyphs.tank_class_glyphs_bonuses: Every 10 seconds, the effect is applied to the ally with the lowest health percentage, increasing armor and magic defense by 37754.71 (1% Health + 24750) for 5.0 seconds. This ability can be used on the tank itself and depends on their maximum Health stat.

counters.reason: Can pull Luther back toward the enemy team.
Can pull Luther back toward the enemy team.

best_teams.description: A strong Yasmine team recommended by Alexandre. Luther reduces nearby enemies' Magic Attack, helping protect Yasmine against one of her weaknesses: magic damage. Dante synergizes with her dodge, Guus supports critical hits and healing, and Byrna provides healing and additional energy gain.
best_teams.alexandre_tips: Esse time ficou muito forte. Um dos pontos fracos da Yasmine é o dano mágico: ao reduzir o Ataque Mágico dos inimigos próximos, Luther ajuda Yasmine a sofrer menos dano mágico. Dante sinergiza com a esquiva dela, Guus com os críticos e a cura, e Byrna com a cura e o ganho de energia extra.
notes: Luther's nearby enemy Magic Attack reduction comes from Unshakable Faith, unlocked at Relic level 30.
Magic Attack reduction does not directly reduce every type of damage; its benefit depends on the enemy skills, positioning, and active battle effects.

best_teams.description: Alternative Yasmine team recommended by Alexandre: Crow with Talisman 2 replaces Byrna. Luther and Yasmine keep Talisman 2, while Dante and Guus keep Talisman 1.
notes: Luther's nearby enemy Magic Attack reduction comes from Unshakable Faith, unlocked at Relic level 30.

old_teams.description: Balanced damage, control, and tankiness. Tristan and Artemis provide damage, Fafnir offers support, Galahad acts as a secondary tank, and Luther serves as the primary tank and crowd control specialist.
Julius adds shields and healing, supporting Luther's ability to disrupt enemy formations.
Cleaver provides additional disruption and crowd control for Luther to capitalize on.
Chabba complements Luther's frontline presence and enhances team sustainability.
Astaroth serves as the primary tank, allowing Luther to focus on crowd control and disruption while Fafnir adds damage and shielding.
Astaroth and Galahad provide a sturdy frontline while Luther controls the battlefield and Tristan and Artemis deal damage.
Sustain and control with Jorgen stealing enemy energy, allowing Luther and Kayla to jump in and disrupt enemy formations.
Yasmine adds damage while Aidan provides healing support, allowing Luther to maintain frontline presence and control.
Mojo's buffs and debuffs complement Luther's crowd control while Fafnir and Artemis provide damage from the backline.
Aurora's dodging enhances team survivability, allowing Luther to stay on the frontline longer.
Jet and Sebastian provide additional critical damage and control, while Galahad acts as a secondary tank alongside Luther.

alexandre_analysis.arena_observation: Testei Luther na Arena e ele realmente está muito forte. Nos meus testes, a redução do Ataque Mágico enfraqueceu bastante os magos do meta, reduzindo muito o dano que conseguiam causar. Luther também aumenta sua própria Defesa Mágica, reforçando sua resistência contra esses ataques. O Talisman 2 é melhor para o Luther por que da mais ataque fisico para as skills dele principalmente para reliquia level 30, porem meu Luther por ainda estar fraco de skins e glifos estava morrendo muito rapido já que estou em um nivel muito alto da arena, por isso precisei mudar para o talisman 1 para que ele nao morresse tao rapido e conseguisse reduzir o ataque magico dos inimigos, mas mesmo assim ele ainda estava morrendo muito rapido, por isso recomendo que se for usar o talisman 2, que se use um tank ou guerreiro secundario no time para proteger a retaguarda, como Tristan ou Byrna.
alexandre_analysis.comparison_context: Approximate maximum-level values supplied by Alexandre. The named enemy heroes use Talisman 1. Each percentage compares a fixed 105666 Magic Attack reduction with the supplied enemy Magic Attack before in-battle changes.

unattributed_source_value.note: This additional Magic Attack value was supplied without a hero name, so it is not assigned to a hero or included in the named comparisons.

alexandre_analysis.conclusion: Com os valores fornecidos, a redução é de aproximadamente 50% a 60% do Ataque Mágico de Kendle, Fólio e Iris no nível máximo. Isso se soma ao aumento de Defesa Mágica do próprio Luther. A redução de Ataque Mágico não é uma redução percentual direta de todo o dano e não garante que o inimigo fique sem dano; o efeito depende de o alvo estar próximo de Luther, que deve permanecer vivo, e dos atributos e efeitos ativos na batalha.

notes: Talisman of Purification is used for Luther in all listed best teams.

Dica do Alexandre: Quando luter salta para o time inimigo ele deixa o time sem tank, mesmo que ele seja o tank, então é importante ter um tank ou guerreiro secundário principalmente que tenha main stats de força no time para manter a posição de proteção da retaguarda, normalmente pode ser usado Tristan, ou até a curandeira byrna.
